notes.title: BAKUDO Hits 50,000 Wishlists!
notes.content: [p]Huge thanks to everyone who's been following and supporting us![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that BAKUDO has officially surpassed 50,000 wishlists on Steam![/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful for all your excitement and support.[/p][p]The team is working hard on the full version—please stay tuned for more updates! 🔥[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645298/a60208ba1824b69e91d43d16e45d5adba1c7bb52.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: BAKUDO Confirmed to Exhibit at "BitSummit the 13th"!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

The newly unveiled 'BAKUDO' from June 2025 will be playable at "BitSummit the 13th"!
We'll also be hosting a BAKUDO Time Attack event at the venue!

Players who achieve an【S Rating】in the boss battle will receive an original T-shirt - limited to the first 5 participants!
This will be BAKUDO's first hands-on event in Japan, so please come challenge yourself when you visit!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645298/e6fa34de670de94050c180124c782d9fdd99f7dc.png"][/img]

We've also prepared special giveaways for attendees:
・Steam Wishlist registration
・Follow the Shueisha Games【Official】-NEWS- X account
Complete either of the above to receive a special postcard!

■BitSummit the 13th
[/p][p]Official URL: [url="https://bitsummit.org/"]https://bitsummit.org/[/url][/p][p]
Event Period: July 18th (Fri) - July 20th (Sun), 2025

We look forward to seeing you there![/p]

notes.title: BAKUDO's Steam Page Is Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that BAKUDO's official Steam page is now live!

[previewyoutube=fFpngdvQtTs;full][/previewyoutube]

Combining school sci-fi, ball-combat sport, action, boss rush, and stylish visuals, BAKUDO promises to deliver intense, heart-pounding combat! 🤛
We'll be releasing more updates about BAKUDO on Steam in the near future, so make sure you add the game to your Wishlist and follow us! 👈️

BAKUDO is a sci‑fi boss‑rush action game fusing high‑octane ball‑sport mechanics with exhilarating combat. Enroll at an elite BAKUDO academy and clash with formidable opponents as you uncover a major conspiracy. When determination is put to the ultimate test, you must tip the scales of destiny.
